description: ConsenSys gnark — Go-native ZK framework. Supports Groth16, Plonk (with/without KZG), and custom constraints. Best fit when the backend is Go (services, indexers, aggregators) and you want circuits + prover in the same binary. Use when prompt names gnark / ConsenSys gnark / wants a Go-based ZK service.

buildHints.whenToUse: Attach on Go backends (go-api, go-worker) that need to generate or verify ZK proofs server-side. Strongest fit for ZK-rollup sequencers, on-chain-proof aggregators, and systems where the prover is infra rather than a user-facing component.
firstSteps: go mod tidy  # pulls gnark + gnark-crypto
Define circuit as a struct implementing frontend.Circuit (Define method)
Verify: `groth16.Verify(proof, vk, publicWitness)` — returns nil on success
gotchas: Witness struct fields match circuit struct fields by NAME, not order. Renaming in one but not the other → silent witness-mismatch.
`api.AssertIsEqual` is the assertion primitive — not Go's `!=`. Using bare comparisons doesn't constrain.
Groth16 needs per-circuit trusted setup. For production, load pk/vk from files you generated with a ceremony; only regenerate for dev.
